meta.scope: Syria Batch 5 — Power/electricity, fiscal balance, and Turkey trade/external densification under extremely constrained conditions.

candidates.title: Electricity generation and capacity statistics
candidates.publisher: Derived from Ministry of Electricity and monitoring sources
candidates.description: Statistics on electricity production and available capacity. Generation remains far below pre-war levels; chronic shortfalls, fuel constraints and damaged infrastructure are structural features. Limited renewable contribution is emerging.
candidates.notes: Core power-system statistical product under severe infrastructure damage.

candidates.title: Fiscal balance and revenue statistics
candidates.publisher: Derived from Ministry of Finance and IMF-aligned monitoring
candidates.description: Fiscal revenue, expenditure and balance indicators under transitional conditions. Recent readings show very constrained absolute revenues and spending relative to pre-war levels; customs and limited hydrocarbon receipts feature among available sources. Budget planning remains highly constrained.
candidates.notes: Core fiscal-flow node under extreme revenue and institutional constraints.

candidates.title: Syria–Turkey merchandise trade statistics
candidates.publisher: Derived from Turkish and Syrian trade monitoring sources
candidates.description: Bilateral trade with Turkey. Volumes have risen in the post-transition period; Turkey is a major source of imports and a key overland trade corridor. Multiple border crossings are active; trade growth is a leading indicator of external re-engagement.
candidates.notes: Primary regional bilateral trade densification under recovery conditions.

candidates.title: Syria power–fiscal–Turkey densification meta-node
candidates.publisher: Derived from energy, fiscal and trade sources
candidates.description: Meta-node binding electricity generation/capacity, fiscal balance/revenue statistics, and Syria–Turkey trade into a coherent infrastructure–fiscal–external residual layer under extremely constrained conditions.
